result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): B has a clear brand anchor: a deep seaweed-ink background with one yellow accent. It feels deliberate for seaweed and avoids the usual health-food look, though the yellow shows up on the badge, headline, logo and button, and the cards use loud mismatched fills. A has well-tinted cream and ink neutrals and a restrained dark button, but no single color reads as the brand: teal, red and mustard all compete. Its product cards also use three loud, unrelated colors. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): A has one clear brand color: a deep seaweed-dark green with a single warm yellow accent. That pairing feels deliberate for a seaweed snack and doesn't look like a typical health-food site. However, A uses the yellow on the badge, logo dot, headline word and button, and its three cards are colored loudly (mint, lime, tan). B is tasteful, with a tinted cream background and dark green-black text, but it has no dominant brand color: teal, red-orange and mustard compete with each other, and its cards are also told apart by loud fills instead of restrained markers.
